# Persona Spec

> An open format for packaging a complete AI persona as a portable, version-controlled folder. A persona folder is an Agent Skill with declarative definition files added. Status: draft 0.1.

Each link below is the raw source of one page.

- [Introduction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/persona-spec/main/README.md): What a persona is and how this repository is laid out.
- [Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/persona-spec/main/src/content/docs/specification.mdx): Folder structure, SKILL.md, the definitions-only rule, resource keys, the registry, definition files and runtime rules.
- [Apps and connectors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/persona-spec/main/src/content/docs/apps.mdx): Connector requirements, connector steps, lists, pipelines and apps, custom app packages, live sync and presence.
- [Examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/persona-spec/main/src/content/docs/examples.mdx): Gabriel's Playbook Studio tab by tab, one prospect taken from research to onboarding, and which persona illustrates each concept.
- [Other standards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/persona-spec/main/src/content/docs/standards.mdx): How the format relates to Agent Skills, the Model Context Protocol and the Standard Agent Specification.

The specification builds on Agent Skills: https://agentskills.io/llms.txt
